title: Crisis red flags and home-assistant boundary / 危急症状边界
text: If a family health note mentions chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, fainting, stroke-like weakness, or rapidly worsening symptoms, the assistant should not reassure the user or diagnose at home. It should preserve the symptom details, mark a crisis escalation, and tell the user to seek urgent medical help or local emergency care. 中文关键词：胸痛、呼吸困难、晕厥、偏瘫、症状快速加重、危急症状、立即就医、不要安慰、不要诊断。

title: Medication missed-dose safety boundary / 漏服用药安全边界
text: When a user asks whether to double a missed medication dose, change a prescribed dose, or combine medicines, the assistant should refuse to give dosing instructions. It can record the medication name, time, blood-pressure reading, and question for the doctor or pharmacist. It should advise following the original prescription or contacting a qualified clinician or pharmacist. 中文关键词：漏服、降压药、能不能吃两片、补服、加倍、剂量调整、用药建议、药师、医生确认、记录血压。

title: Daily blood pressure home log fields / 每日血压记录字段
text: A useful home blood-pressure log records systolic pressure, diastolic pressure, heart rate, measurement time, posture or context, symptoms, medication timing, and whether the reading was repeated. The assistant should organize these values for trend review and doctor visits, not diagnose hypertension severity from one reading. 中文关键词：每日血压、收缩压、舒张压、心率、测量时间、姿势、症状、服药时间、复诊、趋势。

title: OCR report intake and review / OCR 报告识别与核对
text: OCR intake for report photos or PDFs should keep the original source, extracted text, extraction confidence if available, and user correction history. Uncertain lab values, dates, hospital names, and medication names should be shown for review before saving to the health timeline. 中文关键词：OCR、体检报告、照片、PDF、识别文本、置信度、来源、用户核对、不要直接保存、时间线。

title: ASR voice-note intake and correction / 语音转写与确认
text: ASR intake turns a family voice note into a transcript, then sends the transcript through the same medical structuring contract as typed notes. The assistant should store provenance and let the user correct symptom timing, medication names, and negations before saving structured facts. 中文关键词：ASR、语音、转写、症状记录、用户确认、症状时间、用药名称、否定词、保存前核对。

title: Visit-preparation summary / 复诊沟通摘要
text: A visit-preparation summary should collect recent symptoms, onset times, abnormal report items already present in uploaded records, medication questions, daily measurements, and missing fields. It should be concise, source-grounded, and framed as preparation for a clinician conversation rather than a diagnosis. 中文关键词：复诊、医生沟通、就诊准备、摘要、近期症状、起病时间、异常检查、用药问题、每日测量、缺失字段。

title: Structured memory and RAG boundary / SQL 与 RAG 边界
text: Family-specific health memory should stay in structured local storage such as SQLite tables for reports, lab items, symptoms, medications, appointments, safety events, and reminders. RAG should be used for cited public-resource explanations, not for counting private family facts that SQL can answer directly. 中文关键词：SQLite、SQL、结构化健康记忆、血常规次数、半年、家庭事实、RAG、公开资料解释、不要用向量库数私有记录。
